story_text: As a user, I want to filter tasks by category so that I can focus on a specific area.

positive.title: Filter tasks by a valid category that has matching tasks
steps: 1. Send a GET request to /tasks with the query parameter category=Work
2. Verify that the response status code is 200 OK
3. Verify that all returned tasks have category = Work
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · all returned tasks have category = Work

positive.title: Filter tasks by a valid category that has no matching tasks
steps: 1. Send a GET request to /tasks with the query parameter category=Personal
2. Verify that the response status code is 200 OK
3. Verify that the returned array is empty

positive.title: Filter tasks by category — results contain no cross-category contamination
steps: 1. Send a GET request to /tasks with the query parameter category=Work
2. Verify that the response status code is 200 OK
3. Verify that all returned tasks have category = Work
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · only tasks from the specified category are returned

negative.title: Filter tasks by an invalid category
steps: 1. Send a GET request to /tasks with the query parameter category=Invalid
2. Verify that the response status code is 400 Bad Request
3. Verify that the error message indicates valid categories
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message lists valid categories

edge.title: Filter tasks by category with empty value
steps: 1. Send a GET request to /tasks with the query parameter category=
2. Verify that the response status code is 400 Bad Request
3. Verify that the error message indicates valid categories
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · empty value rejected or all tasks returned per spec
